scripts.dev: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --parallel --filter @otkritka/web --filter @otkritka/cms run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @otkritka/web run build && pnpm --filter @otkritka/cms run build
scripts.generate:types: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @otkritka/cms run generate:types
scripts.check: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @otkritka/web run check && pnpm --filter @otkritka/cms run check && eslint .
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:seo
